title: Blackout at the College Fest
call: Inspector {name}, the power was cut at the Spandan college fest, right in the band final.
Two thousand students in the dark. The principal thinks it was on purpose.
arrival: Phone torches everywhere. Two bands glare at each other across the dark stage.

briefing.label: What
briefing.value: The main power cable was cut

briefing.label: Time
briefing.value: 9 PM, as The Rockets walked on stage

examination.title: Examine the power cable

spots.title: Switchboard
spots.text: The main switch is still ON.

spots.title: Cable end
spots.text: Cut clean through, in one go.

spots.title: Floor
spots.text: No sparks, no burns. The cutter knew what they were doing.

examination.question: What caused the blackout?
options: ⚡ A power cut in the city
examination.why: The switch is still on and the cable is cut clean through. Rats chew; they don't cut.

interview.alibi: I was warming up my voice in the green room. Aaa-aaa-aaa!
replies: Backstage pass? Every band member has one.
My bike is electric. No chain, no grease. Look at my hands!
Yes, we'd win. But I want to beat them by singing, not by cheating!
interview.release: The green room camera shows Zoya warming up her voice the whole time.

interview.alibi: I was setting up my drums on the side stage the whole time.
replies: Everyone in a band has a pass, Inspector.
gotchas: That's YOUR bike behind the stage, Bablu. Fresh grease on the chain, and the same grease on these gloves!
You're the one who reminded the committee about this rule yesterday, Bablu!

interview.alibi: I was tuning my guitar in the corridor. Six strings, twenty minutes.
replies: A pass, yes. I'm in the band.
A bike? I came on the college bus, Inspector.
I want to win fair. Our song is better anyway!
interview.release: Two Rockets members saw Nikhil tuning his guitar in the corridor.

leads.from: ✂️ A thick cable, cut clean through
leads.question: That cable is thick, and full of live electricity. What would you need to cut it safely?
options: 🧤 Rubber gloves and a big cutter
wrongWhy: Kitchen scissors can't cut a cable that thick.
A butter knife? It would take all night.
leads.reveal: Gloves and a cutter! You search behind the stage…
leads.name: Rubber gloves
leads.found: **Rubber gloves** and a cable cutter, stuffed in a crate **BACKSTAGE**. Only people with a **backstage pass** can get there. The gloves have black grease on the fingers.
leads.ask: Cross out everyone who does NOT have a backstage pass.
leads.card: Gloves and a cutter hidden BACKSTAGE

leads.from: 🧤 Black grease on the glove fingers
leads.question: The grease is black, thick and oily. Where does that kind of grease come from?
wrongWhy: Cooking oil is yellow and thin, not black.
leads.reveal: A bike chain! You check the bikes behind the stage…
leads.name: Greasy bike
leads.found: One **motorbike** is parked right behind the stage, its chain freshly greased. Its rider fixed it just before the show.
leads.ask: Tap everyone left who rides a bike.
leads.why: Zoya, Bablu and Aryan all ride bikes.
leads.card: GREASE from a bike chain on the gloves

leads.from: 🎸 The power went out just as The Rockets walked on
leads.question: If The Rockets couldn't play, who would win the band final?
wrongWhy: Why would a band ruin its own show?
leads.reveal: Their rivals! You open the fest rule book…
leads.name: Rule book
leads.found: Rule 7: **"If a band can't play, the other band wins."** Only **MIDNIGHT RAGA** gains from the blackout.
leads.ask: Cross out everyone left who is NOT in Midnight Raga.
leads.why: Aryan, Tanya and Sana don't gain anything from it.
leads.card: Only MIDNIGHT RAGA wins if the Rockets can't play

confession: "We lost to the Rockets three years in a row. Not this time. No power, no Rockets."
escapeStory: Bablu rode off on his bike. The traffic police stopped him at the college gate, gloves still in his pocket.
